reuse.why: Fintegra linking goes through the existing linkBankSyncAccount, the guards are added inside that single definition, and Fintegra joins Akahu's balance branch in processBankSyncDownload; only the unlink reset and the download function are not shared.

duplication.why: The take-over path copies unlinkAccount's db.updateAccount reset block, and downloadFintegraTransactions is a near-verbatim copy of downloadAkahuTransactions.

placement.why: Link rules live in linkBankSyncAccount, the download in sync.ts, the URL in server-config and the type in types/models, matching the tree's layering.

scope.why: Focused on the four steps, with release notes; a few handler-entry reorderings are harmless noise.

maintainability.why: All link rules sit in one function every provider uses, so future rules land once; the duplicated reset and download bodies are the remaining cost.

bypasses_abstraction.where: app.ts linkBankSyncAccount clears the old account's link with its own copy of unlinkAccount's db.updateAccount field reset instead of a shared helper

abstraction_drift.where: app.ts linkBankSyncAccount gains replaceExistingLink and a branch releasing existing links instead of throwing; all six provider link functions route through it
